integrated_multimodal_description: Claymation plasticine stop-motion, handcrafted modelling clay with visible fingerprints and matte finish, photographed on a miniature practical set. a small military vehicle-wash bay of riveted grey steel plates. Wet grey concrete floor, two faded yellow safety lines, one rectangular drain hole at centre with the grate lying face down beside it, red-wheel water valves and a coiled hose reel on the left wall, electric cabinets and a broom on the right wall, two stacked steel drums at rear right, a white canvas curtain on a ceiling rail at the back, a bare chain with a hook above the drain, two caged industrial lamps. Cool hard overhead light, short shadows, wet surfaces. TEO (frame left): tall thin white clay man, huge straw-blond walrus moustache, teal knitted beanie with cream stripes, red-and-black checked flannel shirt, brown suspenders, khaki trousers, dark boots. JUCA (frame right): short wide Black clay man, burnt-brown flat cap, mustard cable-knit sweater, olive-green trousers, pale wooden clogs, pencil behind the right ear. Exactly two clay puppets appear in the frame: TEO stays at frame left and JUCA stays at frame right; no other people or animals appear. AT START: empty steel drum rolling across the bay with the steel grate balanced flat on top; client gone; phone box crushed under the toppled dolly. [Shot 1] Close insert of the open drain throat, a black rectangular hole in the wet concrete, with TEO's brass tape hook resting on its front rim. [Shot 2] At 00:03.500, the camera cuts to the camera cuts to a wide shot: JUCA stamps an oversized rubber test plug into the hole with his heel, the rubber swells past the rim and fires the plug straight up, and it bounces down onto TEO's boot, while TEO holds the tape hook out and lock mid-measure. [Shot 3] At 00:07.000, the camera cuts to the camera cuts to a low two-shot: TEO lifts that boot off the floor with the swollen plug stuck to it like a slipper and holds the raised knee; JUCA leans in with both hands on his thighs to look at it too. They do not speak and their mouths do not move, but they breathe, swallow and react with their whole bodies. AT END: rubber test plug swollen and stuck to TEO's boot; drain hole still open; tape measure clattered on the floor.
overall_soundscape: Rubber squeaks against the concrete rim, a wet pop fires the plug upward, and it slaps onto a leather boot while a tape measure clatters down. TEO huffs once through his nose. JUCA lets out a low sigh.
